name: [FREE AVA] Gunung YNTKTS [ONE PIECE EDITION]
desc:
"WELCOME BACK TO OUR HOME"
For the climbers who have traveled far...
For those who once started everything here...
Mountain YNTKTS is calling you to go home.

Return to the place where your first wounds occurred, where your first memories were recorded, and where we all used to joke around together.
Return to the home that is always waiting, the home where we are all together, YNTKTS always welcomes you, we miss you all.
